A chord with line \(2x+y=p\) gives the intersection equation  

\[
x^{2}=16(p-2x)\;\Longrightarrow\;x^{2}+32x-16p=0 .
\]

If the roots are \(x_{1},x_{2}\), Vieta gives  

\[
x_{1}+x_{2}=-32,\qquad x_{1}x_{2}=-16p .
\]

\[
h=\frac{x_{1}+x_{2}}{2}=-16,
\]

\[
k=\frac{y_{1}+y_{2}}{2}= \frac{2p-2(x_{1}+x_{2})}{2}=p+32 .
\]

\[
\Delta =32^{2}+64p=1024+64p>0\;\Longrightarrow\;p>-16 .
\]

\[
h=-16,\qquad k=p+32,\qquad p>-16 .
\]
